C0226.title: US Government Websites Hit by SEO Poisoning Attack
C0226.summary: In December 2025, SC Media and Cybernews reported that .gov domains across multiple U.S. state and local government sites were affected by an SEO poisoning attack. Attackers placed PDFs or pages containing redirect links in publicly accessible locations on government websites; once indexed by search engines, users clicking official-domain results were redirected to AI-porn ads, chatbots, adult products, and other illicit pages. The reports cited at least 38 .gov sites across 18 states.
